fields.statement: QA round 3 at db1b1c925, scratch build (go build -trimpath, run by full path, outside PATH) driving autonomous plan runs by hand in scratch Rhiza roots with the plan-workflow-autonomous* fake rex/claude/gh: after round 3, rhiza run status showed both review questions as '— decision settle-…' with no 'not yet delivered' and their --json had no session field; a session's question (planner's, plan-workflow-autonomous fakes) carried session in --json, and with its answered journal entry removed printed '— decision assume-streaming, not yet delivered'.
